Fullask 1.0.0 Changelog

- Initial release providing automated logistics index analysis and operational suggestions.
- Supports querying logistics index score, industry average, ranking, and seven-day trend.
- Identifies key sub-indicators impacting ranking, with fixed analysis on "揽收及时率".
- Reads exception details and summarizes non-compliant categories and proportions.
- Requires carrier name and statistical date as inputs.
